rationale: No evidence-supported optimization cleanly applies to this release image-build workflow. P-LIT-GHA-CACHE requires a dependency-install step with a measurable fetch and a lockfile/environment cache key, but the workflow has no pip/npm/apt install step in the YAML itself (package installation happens inside the encapsulated usimd/pi-gen-action Docker build, not as a cacheable workflow step). P-LIT-FAIL-FAST is unsuitable because the matrix builds two distinct release images (32bit and 64bit) and both outcomes are required products; the workflow already sets fail-fast: false. P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE is contraindicated because this is a release/deployment workflow. P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT lacks a verified safe bound; the CI history shows successful runs but no per-job duration distribution that would justify a custom timeout without risking valid slow builds. P-LIT-CHANGE-FILTER does not fit a workflow_dispatch-only release pipeline. Preserving the intended build and test coverage means no change is warranted.
